Five Star Luxury Stays
Surrounded by glorious Kent countryside, Hever Castle’s accommodation offers you the experience of enjoying a leisurely stay in 25 ‘five star gold’ luxury bedrooms in the Astor Wing and the Anne Boleyn Wing, both Edwardian Wings attached to the Castle built in Tudor style.
A leisurely breakfast is included with every bedroom stay, served in elegant surroundings to help you start the day at a relaxed pace.
Tickets to the Castle & Gardens are included with every stay and do not need to be booked separately online, allowing guests to explore the grounds and gardens at their leisure.
Reception is staffed Monday – Friday 9am – 5pm and can be contacted to check availability, make a booking, or if you have any questions pertaining to an existing booking.

Astor Wing
Bookings in the Astor Wing can be taken eight weeks in advance of the date you wish to stay.
The Astor Wing offers a beautifully panelled lounge with deep sofas and a selection of books and magazines for guests to relax with during their stay. There’s also a rather splendid Billiards Room to be discovered.
(Bedrooms are available to book ahead of eight weeks when booked as part of a wedding  or  private hire )
Anne Boleyn Wing
Bookings in the Anne Boleyn Wing can be up to six months in advance of the date you wish to stay.
The Anne Boleyn Wing enjoys its own beautiful Breakfast Room which is flooded with natural daylight and offers window seats looking out across the orchard to the Castle.
Guests who book an Anne Boleyn Wing bedroom will have access to the lounge and Billiards Room, located in the Astor Wing, on dates when there are no private events booked into the Astor Wing.
(Bedrooms are available to book ahead of six months when booked as part of a wedding  or  private hire )
Rates
Bedrooms at Hever Castle s Luxury Accommodation have been categorised as either ‘Superior, Feature, Deluxe, Standard or Single’ and there are also two special Suites, the Willow Suite and the ‘Edward VII’ Suite for those extra special occasions. There is a pricing structure for each category based on what day of the week you wish to stay.
Our bedrooms are competitively priced and offer great value given the five star rating that they have been awarded. A sumptuous breakfast is included in the price of all bedrooms, offering a traditional English menu cooked to order and a healthy continental option as well.

Our Rooms
All bedrooms are en-suite and individually styled, with some offering four poster beds, roll top baths or walk in showers. Blending traditional features with modern day luxuries, each bedroom offers its own unique charm and character.
Rooms have been classified as Superior, Feature, Deluxe, Standard or Single, and for those extra special occasions, we have two stunning suites Willow and Edward VII. The majority of the rooms are double, however, there are twin bedrooms and one single bedroom available.
Children are welcome and there a couple of rooms that are suitable for families. There are bedrooms that can accommodate one of our z-beds or our cots, available for children under the age of twelve.  There are also a couple of bedrooms that have a sofa bed in them that can accommodate two small children.
Willow Suite
Willow Suite is the most recent addition to the Astor Wing. This beautifully appointed and spacious first floor Suite is both indulgent and sophisticated, presenting elegant interiors, fine fabrics and period furnishings.
The piece-de-resistance of this Suite is the quirky and cosy small room accommodating a canopy-style day bed that will delight and enthral your little ones imagination. Should sleeping arrangements for two children be required, there’s ample room for a truckle bed in the foyer.
A spacious panelled bathroom completes the Willow Suite, with a stunning 20 th  century inspired slipper bath and a large walk-in tiled rainfall shower.
Edward VII Suite
The Edward VII Suite provides a real treat for that special occasion or just because.
The suite offers a Romanesque 7ft bed with ornate pillars, a spacious living area with a deep sofa and armchairs positioned next to the leaded windows that look out across an apple orchard and onto the Castle.
Flooded with natural daylight the suite oozes charm and sophistication. The part panelled bathroom features a large walk in shower and a claw foot bath.
Superior Rooms
Our superior rooms speak for themselves, with some offering stunning views across the apple orchard to the Castle or the Tudor lawns and the moat, and others boasting regal four poster beds.
You may discover a chaise longue, a roll top bath, antique furnishings and luxury beyond expectation.
Tea and coffee making facilities are available in all rooms and luxurious toiletries are provided. Wi-Fi, flat screen digital TV’s and direct-dial telephones are in every bedroom.
Feature Rooms
Pure luxury combined with regal grandeur, exquisite elegance and charm.
All rooms offer different features such as ornate fireplaces or stunning views across the formal lawns. There’s even an original and rather quirky ‘Astor bath’ on offer in the feature twin room.

Five Star Luxury Stays
Within the stunning grounds of the Hever Castle Estate, there are two opportunities for you to stay the night with us. If you re looking to stay in a castle in Kent, we offer luxurious accommodation to suit a range of visitors. As one of the most unique castles to stay in Kent, one option is to stay in one of our five-star luxury bedrooms, located in the Astor Wing and the Anne Boleyn Wing, an Edwardian wing attached to the historic castle and connected internally. The other is our five-star Gold-rated holiday cottage, Medley Court, attached to the Astor Wing.
Tickets to the Castle & Gardens are included with every booking and do not need to be booked separately when booking a stay with us, making Hever Castle one of the finest castles to stay in Kent for an unforgettable short break.

Bedrooms
We offer collection of 25 stunning ‘five star’ bedrooms located in the Astor Wing and Anne Boleyn Wing of Hever Castle, an Edwardian Wing attached to the castle and connected inside. Available to book up to six months in advance, subject to availability
Holiday Cottage
A luxurious four bedroom ‘five star gold’ rated property, forming part of the Astor Wing. Accommodating up to 8 guests, Medley Court can be booked for a week or more stay up to a year in advance, or a minimum of two nights for short lead bookings, eight weeks in advance, subject to availability.
Stay at Hever Castle this Christmas
Enjoy a magical Christmas getaway at Hever Castle with an overnight stay in our five-star luxury accommodation. Perfect for a festive family escape, you can explore A Nutcracker s Christmas and, for families with little ones, add an optional visit to Father Christmas to make the experience extra special.
The William Waldorf Bar
Introducing The William Waldorf Bar, an elegant new addition nestled within Hever Castle s Luxury Accommodation.
Inspired by the legacy of William Waldorf Astor and the heritage of Hever Castle, the bar offers guests a refined setting to unwind, celebrate and enjoy their stay within one of England s most celebrated historic estates.
Guests can enjoy a carefully curated selection of fine wines, expertly crafted cocktails, local beers and premium spirits all served in elegant surroundings designed to complement the charm and character of the historic estate. Designed with comfort in mind, the fully air-conditioned bar offers the perfect place to escape the warmth and unwind with your favourite drink.
Open Monday Sunday | 2pm 10:30pm
Eden Restaurant
Introducing Eden, a small and intimate restaurant set within the heart of the Hever Castle Estate and named after the River Eden that runs through it.
Under the direction of George Blogg MCA, the skilled team dedicate themselves to providing the highest guest experience using delicious and naturally inspired food.
Exclusively for accommodation guests and evening diners, Eden will bring together exceptional food and the unique atmosphere of one of England s most iconic historic settings.
Golf Breaks
For the ultimate golf break in Kent, stay in five-star luxury in the accommodation at Hever Castle and play our 18 hole Championship Course, which forms part of the Hever Castle Estate, offering a truly inspirational setting for a golf break.

About Hever Castle | Hever Castle
About Hever Castle
The Hever Castle Estate has a wealth of history; most recognisably it was the childhood home of Anne Boleyn. Today the Estate has something for everyone. This diverse offering and the independent ownership of the Castle make Hever a truly unique place to visit, stay, work and experience.
Hever Castle
The original medieval defensive castle, with its gatehouse and walled bailey, was built in 1383. In the 15 th  and 16 th  centuries it was the home of one of the most powerful families in the country, the Boleyns, who modernised the existing dwelling within the walls. The Castle was then owned by a number of families before William Waldorf Astor invested time, money and imagination in restoring the Castle, building the ’Tudor Village’ and creating the gardens, Lake and Golf Club.
The Guthries, a Yorkshire family based in Scarborough are the current owners of the Hever Castle Estate. John Guthrie, a chartered surveyor by training, chairs the private property group Broadland Properties founded in 1950. Broadland Properties purchased Hever Castle and its collection from the Astor family in 1983.
Broadlands are committed to the future of the Castle. During their custodianship have invested greatly in the historical integrity of the estate and are helping to make Hever Castle more environmentally friendly.
Today our mission is to conserve and improve the Hever Castle Estate whilst maintaining its integrity, and making its important history available to inform and educate our visitors. We endeavour to ensure an enjoyable, engaging and memorable experience for all in a beautiful, fun and safe environment.
Awards
We are immensely proud of the team that make Hever Castle & Gardens such a success. From those you see out in the gardens and Castle, to those typing away in the offices – thank you.
Our hard work has been recognised by various organisations so we wanted to share the good news with you.

Sustainability

Recruitment
It takes a great team with wide-ranging skills to look after and manage the Hever Castle Estate. From visitor experience executive to events coordinator, we’ve got something for everyone. Are you passionate, hardworking and social? If so, take a look at our vacancies.

Hever Castle FAQs
FAQs
Below are a few questions that we get asked regularly that may help you to plan your day out.
FAQs regarding our accommodation can be found here: Luxury Accommodation FAQs and Medley Court FAQs .
Do you have an access guide?
Yes, this access guide does not contain personal opinions as to our suitability for those with access needs, but aims to accurately describe the facilities and services that we offer all our visitors. Further information and the current accessibility statement can be found  here .
Do you allow dogs in the grounds?
We welcome dogs in the grounds as long as they’re kept on a lead at all times and in all areas of the grounds including Lake Walk, Woodland Walk, the jousting field and even on the Rowing Boats. With the exception of assistance dogs, dogs or other animals are not allowed inside the cafés, restaurants, shops, Castle, mazes, play areas or Festival Theatre.  There are water bowls provided for them at both our Moat Restaurant and at the Guthrie Pavilion Café  where there is also outside seating. There is a stand where dogs can be tied and left in the Castle Courtyard if you wish to visit the castle, but this is not supervised and they are left at your own risk. We request that you do not leave dogs in your car whilst visiting on warm days. Dogs are not permitted in the Luxury Bed & Breakfast accommodation.
Please clear up after your dog.
Please consider the wellbeing of your dog before deciding whether to bring them along on a hot day.
Do you allow picnics in the grounds?
We do allow picnics. You are welcome to bring your own picnic to enjoy at one of the many picnic areas in the grounds. Horse Shoe Lawn provides a perfect setting with sun and shade and a picturesque castle view. Half Moon Lawn is another popular choice with views of the pond, fountain and pretty bridges across the moat. Venture further afield and you will discover Two Sisters’ Lawn adjacent to the Theatre which is surrounded by delightful flower beds and an abundance of ornamental trees. Or follow signs for Lake Walk and choose a secluded spot.
During our Christmas event there are limited areas for picnics but visitors are welcome to bring them.
Do you allow bikes and scooters in the grounds?
No, for health and safety reasons and because the gardens are Grade I listed we do not allow bikes or scooters in the grounds. Bike racks are available at the main entrance for cyclists.
Are you members of the National Trust or English Heritage?
Hever Castle and Gardens is privately owned and we are not part of the National Trust or English Heritage.
Do you have wheelchairs available and how to book one?
We have four manual wheelchairs available for hire with a refundable deposit of £25.00 per wheelchair. Advance booking is essential (same-day bookings are not available). To reserve a wheelchair, please call the Shop between 10am and 3pm at +44 (0)1732 861718 . Payment can be made by cash or card on the day, though please note that card refunds may take up to 10 days to process.
For your safety, we recommend that wheelchair users and mobility scooters remain on the hard-surfaced shingle paths. Wheelchairs are thoroughly cleaned before each use.
Please note, we are unable to supply wheelchairs for Festival Theatre performances.
Can we take photographs inside the Castle and Gardens?
We encourage visitors photography on site and love seeing visitors photos on social media. To protect paintings and objects, copyright of loans, individual privacy and the overall visitor experience we do not permit tripods, selfie sticks and flash photography in the Castle. In the grounds, please use tripods with caution and awareness of other visitors. Should they cause a hazard we may ask you to stop or move.
Please note that professional portrait, engagement, pre-wedding or wedding day photography are not permitted without prior written permission. More information can be found here .
Commercial photography or filming is not permitted onsite without prior permission, however, we welcome commercial filming enquiries. More information can be found here .
Can we visit the restaurant without paying entry?
If you make a reservation for the Guthrie Pavilion Restaurant you must also purchase at least a Gardens Only ticket, this is because the restaurant is located well within our gardens and grounds.
What kind of food does the café(s) serve?
The Moat Café serves a wide range of hot and cold meals. The food is seasonal and so changes often, but you can expect to find a selection of fresh baguettes and sandwiches, light bites such as quiche and soup and full meals such as fish and chips. Children’s portions are also available. If you have any special dietary requirements, please let us know. Find out more about our Eateries .
How do I book a table at the restaurant?
At the Castle & Gardens, you can only book for Mother s Day Weekend and select dates at Christmas.
Located one mile from the Castle & Gardens at Hever Castle Golf & Wellbeing is The Waterside Bar, Restaurant & Terrace. Discover more  here .
Do I get a discount for using a reusable cup?
Yes! Bring your reusable cup and you’ll receive 25p off any hot drink at the   Moat Grab & Go, Guthrie Pavilion Restaurant and other onsite catering outlets .   Annual Members enjoy even more you’ll get the 25p reusable-cup discount plus 10% off your total bill .
How to get a replacement annual membership card?
If you lose your Annual Membership card we can replace it for you, simply ask on entry or at the Information Hut. If you need your details to make a booking, please contact the Estate Office on 01732 865224.
Can I buy tickets/annual membership from overseas?
We can now accept payments from outside of the UK. Diners cards are not accepted.
What are the benefits of being an annual member?
Please find all the benefits of annual membership  here .
